Ndeipi chirevo chinotsanangura basa $W$ nekukasira $a$ zvakanaka?
20261118-physics-g11.s.s1.prompt: [H2 Ongororo yeFizikisi] Dambudziko rinoshandisa misimboti ye Simba, kufamba ne relativity. 20261121-physics-g11-1.title: Simba, kufamba ne relativity
20261121-physics-g11-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Simba, kufamba ne relativity kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261121-physics-g11-1.material: [H2 Ongororo yeFizikisi (Pamberi)] Ongororo yekufamba kwekudonha pachena kune chekuita ne Simba, kufamba ne relativity. Chinhu chinodonhedzwa kubva pakuzorora pasina mweya pasi pegiravhiti $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Chii chinonzi velocity $v$ nenhambwe $h$ yakadonha mushure me $t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.prompt: [H2 Ongororo yeFizikisi (Pamberi)] Ongororo yekufamba kwekudonha pachena kune chekuita ne Simba, kufamba ne relativity. Chinhu chinodonhedzwa kubva pakuzorora pasina mweya pasi pegiravhiti $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Chii chinonzi velocity $v$ nenhambwe $h$ yakadonha mushure me $t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.explain:
Danho 1: Velocity $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Danho 2: Nhambwe $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Danho 3: Saka $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ uye $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.
